name: Two-pass transparent meshing with opaque separation
definition: A meshing strategy that separates opaque and transparent geometry into two passes to ensure correct rendering order and reduce overdraw, by generating opaque faces between air/transparent blocks and transparent faces only for blocks touching air.
summary: Two-pass transparent meshing with opaque separation is a voxel rendering strategy that decouples opaque and transparent geometry into distinct passes to ensure correct rendering order and reduce overdraw.
